notes.title: Improved controls + Graphics options + Achievements in Update #2
notes.content:
Dear customers,

it's been a week since Through the Woods has been released and we kept collecting your feedback in order to bring you another update. The patch is now live and here's a list of what it fixes:

- Added Achievements
- Expanded graphics settings in the main menu. You can now tweak various options to improve performance
- Configure controls (BETA) - launch the external configurator to access the Input menu, where you can re-map keyboard and gamepad controls
- Fixed skybox on 21:9 resolutions
- Improved encounters
- Small gameplay tweaks
- Language fixes

That's it for now. We'll be looking forward to your feedback!


Recap of Update #1

- Mouse cursor is no longer visible during gameplay 
- Fixed stretched skybox when using other screen ratio than 16:9 
- Resolution no longer resets during loading 
- Optimised shadows in early levels 
- Reduced global reflection update 
- Added cloud saves

notes.title: Trading cards available, achievements in progress, new update in the works
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

we keep on improving the game based on your feedback. One of the requests was to add trading cards and achievements. Good news - Trading Cards are here! Now you have another reason to re-visit the game, collect more of the story items (if you missed some) and maybe even find 7 hidden carvings for our MSI Vortex content. Achievements are coming soon!

We will also bring you an update that will allow you to rebind the keys very soon. There will be more fixes (like fixed skybox for 21:9 resolutions) and we will let you know as soon as it is available.

Thanks for all your support. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update #1 Live + Halloween contest
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we're excited that after years of hard work, Through the Woods is finally released. But that doesn't mean we're stopping here. Even though the initial feedback was very positive, some of you are experiencing sub-optimal performance of the game. We're taking your feedback very seriously, so we will do our best to improve your experience.

Right now, we have released Update #1, which fixes the following things:

- Mouse cursor is no longer visible during gameplay
- Fixed stretched skybox when using other screen ratio than 16:9
- Resolution no longer resets during loading
- Optimized shadows in early levels
- Reduced global reflection update
- Added cloud saves

We will keep investigating reported issues further and of course we'll post updates to social media and community hub. Thank you all for your feedback!

Also, we would like to remind you that there are three contests running on Facebook [url=http://www.facebook.com/1CCompany]HERE[/url]. You can enter the contests to win copies of the game, Steam Controllers, Steam Links and even a MSI Vortex Gaming PC.

Last, but not least - Trading Cards, Badges and other awards are coming early next week!
